notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.
